plan.notes: Official 'Psychology' BS degree map, College of Education, Health and Human Studies (36-hr major, minor required; grade of C or better required in core courses; 39 senior-division hours required). All 8 semester grids transcribed verbatim; row sums match declared term totals (16/15/15/15/15/15/15/14); grand total 120cr. Extended Core = one course from each of four areas (Basic/Cognitive, Clinical/Personality, Developmental, Social/Applied). Optional Pre-Counseling track (no minor required if chosen) noted but not separately sequenced. Guide based on the 2026-2027 Undergraduate Bulletin (revised 4/23/2026); retrieved 2026-10-09.
